comment: SosrG v2 design tokens — redesign.md §1-4. Canonical source per redesign.md §11 (app-readiness for a future native app). src/design-system/tokens.css must be kept in sync with these same values by hand — the token set is small enough that a codegen step would be overhead, not a safeguard.

color._tier-color-note: Green/Red account tiers reuse success/danger. Yellow/Blue are new tokens proposed for the Badge/StatusPill component per redesign.md §1's own escape hatch for a genuinely-needed second accent — measured contrast vs navy-900: tier-yellow 6.67:1, tier-blue 5.64:1 (both pass AA).

breakpoint.comment: Mobile (320-480px) is the unqueried default per redesign.md §4 — these three are min-width thresholds

spacing.comment: No custom spacing scale defined — Tailwind v4's default scale (p-1..p-32 etc.) already produces exactly the 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64/96/128px scale specified in redesign.md §4, so component code just uses Tailwind's built-in spacing utilities directly.
